# US-1 Pools

> Family-owned pool sales, service, and installation company in Franklinton, North Carolina. Founded 2015. NC licensed and CPO certified. Owners Shayne and Cathy Parrish have been in the pool industry since 1986. Serves Franklin and surrounding counties: Wake Forest, Youngsville, Louisburg, Raleigh, Durham, Henderson.

US-1 Pools handles the full pool lifecycle: above-ground installs, in-ground custom builds, fiberglass pools, hot tubs and swim spas, weekly maintenance, openings and closings, equipment repair, liner replacement, water testing, and retail (chemicals, cleaners, toys). Authorized dealer for Latham, GLI, Imagine Fiberglass, Pools by Genesis, Tranquility, Garden Leisure, and Maytronics Dolphin.

## Quick facts

- Founded: 2015
- License: North Carolina licensed pool contractor
- Certifications: CPO (Certified Pool Operator)
- Awards: 2023 Best of the Best, 2025 Best of the Best
- Financing: LightStream and HFS programs
- Payment methods: Cash, credit card, financing
- Service radius: 30 minutes from Franklinton, NC (Franklin, Wake, Durham, Vance counties)
- Subcontractors used: None — in-house crew on every install
- Permitting: Handled in-house including HOA coordination
- Water care alternatives offered: Salt-based, oxygen pools (chlorine alternatives)
